_note: The night's three scenes, played on the board (Play.md 'Cutscenes'). Each shot: at (board, foyer, player, taken, fall), seconds, distance [from, to] in metres, yaw [from, to] in degrees around the target, tilt in degrees, the caption line, and a clip the shot's figure plays (talk, attack, power, hit or none). Lines may use {player}, {guest} (the Taken's own name), {taken} (its risen name) and {survivors}.

opening.line: Saigon, seven in the evening. The Opera House opens its doors for one last gala.
Seven guests were invited by a patron none of them has met.
You are {player}. Find what you came for before midnight.

midnight.line: Midnight. Somewhere below the stage, a bell nobody rang.
{guest} stops in the dark and does not breathe.
What rises is not {guest} any more. It is {taken}.

ending_company.line: Dawn reaches the Opera House. {survivors} walk out into the morning.

ending_taken.line: The theatre keeps its guests. The gala will be held again.
